title: LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy Renewal Offer — Recording the Indicated Renewal Premium
content:
A LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy renewal that has reached the tier's renewal offer lead time before expiration without an indicated renewal premium on the policy is offered on the day it is found, and the offer date is that day. When the renewal is offered, the indicated renewal premium for the upcoming twelve-month term is recorded on the policy record.

## Recording condition

For a building on file as vacant longer than the tier's vacancy exclusion period, the indicated renewal premium is recorded only after the policy carries a vacancy permit whose dates cover the offer date.

Put the other way round: while the policy record shows the building vacant for longer than the tier's vacancy exclusion period and shows no vacancy permit whose first day is on or before the offer date and whose last day is on or after it, no indicated renewal premium is recorded. For an occupied building, or one vacant no longer than that period, this condition does not arise.

## Situation of use and capability

`record_renewal_indication_d716047a` records the renewal offer's indicated premium on one LandlordGuard dwelling policy. One call writes the premium indicated for the upcoming twelve-month term onto the policy record, replacing any indication already shown there. Nothing is billed and the current term is not changed.

## How it is invoked

The tool is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `record_renewal_indication_d716047a`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `dwelling_policy_id` | the reference id of the landlord dwelling policy record being offered for renewal, as returned by the dwelling policy lookup for the verified caller | identifier |
| `indicated_renewal_premium` | the indicated annual premium for the upcoming term, in USD | positive amount to 2 decimal places; a value with more places is rounded half-up to 2 decimal places when recorded |

## Return

A one-line receipt: "Renewal indication recorded on policy <dwelling_policy_id>: indicated renewal premium <indicated_renewal_premium> USD." The policy is echoed and the amount is shown to 2 decimal places. Receiving this line means the indication is on the policy, where it is then visible.

## Basis Q&A

**Does recording the indication bill the landlord?** No. The call writes the indicated premium onto the policy only; nothing is billed and the current term is unchanged.

**What if an indication is already on the policy?** A new call replaces the indication shown there.
